svg.title: Hapa Versus proposed contextual board interface
svg.desc: Three illustrative proposed screen states: a quiet board with physical Card banks and player Fire Pits and Mana basins, an enlarged Card hover view, and party inspection with a large chess identity, formation, and a hollow destination marker. This is a design schematic, not runtime evidence. No permanent external hand or right inspector appears.

g.text: PROPOSED LAYOUT · illustrative schematic · not runtime evidence
The board carries Cards, pieces and resources.

One persistent game state. Detail appears at the object you are inspecting.
Quiet play keeps phase, Orders / Ready and public resources available. Required responses open a persistent decision surface.
Both owners and all Card types share inspection. Hover has keyboard / touch equivalents. “n” denotes an illustrative count placeholder.
Visual composition only: positions, art, quantities and movement shown here are placeholders, not an approved match or rules example.
